description.value: Sportstop Source for Sports is a member of Canada's largest sporting goods buying group (Source for Sports), located in the Crystal Lodge North Wing in Whistler Village. The shop carries sporting goods and sportswear serving the outdoor enthusiast community in one of BC's premier mountain resort destinations. A touring cyclist passing through may find outdoor apparel, accessories, and general sports gear here.
